notes: Cureus 2024;16(3):e57356, RML Lucknow, ICU blood cultures, June 2022-June 2023, 669 samples, 213 (31.8%) growth. Susceptibility data is in bar-chart figures (Figure 1 gram-positive, Figure 2 gram-negative), NOT text tables; extracted the printed data-labels from the embedded chart images (rendered via pymupdf). Charts report %SUSCEPTIBLE (sensitivity), so from_R=false throughout. Enterococcus reported as 'Enterococcus species' (not split) -> mapped to canonical 'Enterococcus'; clindamycin bar for Enterococcus had no printed value so omitted. Acinetobacter reported as 'Acinetobacter species' -> mapped to 'Acinetobacter baumannii' (core organism). Resistance-mechanism context (Table 2/text): MRSA 77.6% of S. aureus (cefoxitin S=22.4 matches), methicillin-resistant CoNS 66%; overall MBL producers 64.3% of gram-negatives (Acinetobacter 71%, K. pneumoniae 65.9%, P. aeruginosa 68.4%, E. coli 60%); ESBL 19.6% overall (K. pneumoniae 26.8%). VITEK 2 / CLSI M100 2022. Testing was for cefoxitin, erythromycin, clindamycin, tetracycline, ciprofloxacin, chloramphenicol, vancomycin, linezolid, gentamicin, teicoplanin, ampicillin-sulbactam, ceftazidime, imipenem, piperacillin-tazobactam, amikacin.
